subject.title: feat: let plugin tools yield turns

question: Should OpenClaw permanently support an opt-in Plugin SDK `AgentToolResult.control` / `yieldToolResult(...)` contract that maps plugin tool completion to the embedded `sessions_yield` lifecycle?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically bounded and has real runtime proof, but choosing a durable public Plugin SDK control surface and its compatibility promise requires maintainer product and API ownership judgment.

options.title: Accept the opt-in SDK contract
options.body: Approve the result-level `yield` control with the documented `canYield: true` plus sequential-execution requirements and retain explicit errors for unsupported runtimes.

options.title: Prefer a different plugin seam
options.body: Pause this PR and define a different owner-approved Plugin SDK lifecycle API before exposing a permanent public helper.

recommendation.title: Accept the opt-in SDK contract
recommendation.body: Approve the result-level `yield` control with the documented `canYield: true` plus sequential-execution requirements and retain explicit errors for unsupported runtimes.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposed control deliberately reuses the existing `sessions_yield` lifecycle identified in the PR discussion as this person's adjacent implementation area.
